answer: Sybil fleets die on latency, so make trust lag deliberately. A new key starts in a hollow tier: it may read and attest low-stakes work but cannot earn until it survives several full reward cycles unbroken. Each cycle demands a fresh proof of work whose difficulty is seeded by the epoch hash, so a farm must pay compute per identity, per round. Standing is a yarrow stalk — thin, slow, and easily crushed by one missed pulse of honest participation.
